basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old aspiring medical student from Austin, Texas. Currently, I'm working part-time as a freelance writer while gaining clinical experience to strengthen my med school application. I have a passion for technology and often indulge in gaming during my free time. I'm also an avid cat lover and enjoy collecting items for my feline friend. My online presence peaks during the evenings, typically after 7 PM CST, when I can unwind from the day's activities. I'm single and prefer spending my free time with close friends or exploring new tech gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in biology from the University of Texas, my interest in the medical field has been longstanding. I've also taken several online courses on medical transcription and scribing. My tech-savvy nature is self-taught, as I've always been intrigued by the latest tech advancements and enjoy keeping up with new trends.
